doc: I59 historical replay: disagreements between the frozen M0 header model and the real code on real on-chain parent headers (holon.historical.replay). dec_go / ok_go against the real Go decoders of the pinned checkout; ok_sol against the chain's acceptance of the header in a successful commit. Ids are holon.refinement.disagreement_id(edge, input); class is holon.refinement.classify(entry) computed from links only ({} for a new entry: unexplained).
